forensic.summary: Earnings growth is mostly real (volume, price, mix) but two items flatter it: buybacks and stretched receivables.

findings.claim: Gross margin expansion came from price and software mix; durable unless competitors' bundling forces price cuts.

evidence.quote: Gross margin improved to 40.0% from 38.9% as a result of price increases and a favorable product mix toward software subscriptions.

findings.claim: Receivables grew faster than revenue because two large customers received longer payment terms: a working-capital quality watch item.

evidence.quote: Accounts receivable increased to $700 million from $600 million, primarily due to longer payment terms granted to two large customers.

findings.claim: Buybacks shrank the diluted share count 2.4%, contributing about 2.4 points of the 24.4% EPS growth.

business.summary: Good business with real switching costs, but mid-market pricing pressure and customer concentration are live issues.

findings.claim: Embedded sensors and a subscription platform create switching costs, shown by high renewal rates.

evidence.quote: Customers who adopted our software platform renewed at a rate of 94% in fiscal 2025.

findings.claim: Competitor bundling in the mid-market threatens pricing and gross margin.

evidence.quote: could reduce our gross margin by up to 150 basis points

findings.claim: Customer concentration raises the cost of any single contract loss.

evidence.quote: Our largest ten customers accounted for 31% of fiscal 2025 revenue

valuation.summary: At $50 the market already prices double-digit FCF growth for a decade; guidance does not support that.

findings.claim: The current price implies about 11.6% annual FCF growth for ten years (9% discount rate, 3% terminal growth); guidance is 8-10% revenue growth.

evidence.quote: we expect revenue growth of 8% to 10% and operating margin of 16% to 17%

red_team.summary: Even the base case underperforms the S&P; the stock is exposed to multiple compression and a 2027 refinancing.

findings.claim: A de-rating from 33x to 22x earnings alone would cut the price about a third even if guidance is met.

evidence.quote: we expect revenue growth of 8% to 10% and operating margin of 16% to 17%
